items.text: Archie is on screen.
Dog walker is on screen.
No one is on screen except: Archie, Dog walker.
Archie is the only person in the foreground, matching the man in Archie_biz_sprite_master.png (same outfit, hair and build).
The woman with the dog is no longer at her spot from james_meeting_1.png. She is walking away at the far right of the frame, or just leaving it.
No third person is standing with Archie. Only passers-by already in james_exterior.png appear.
Archie stands in the same spot on the street as in james_meeting_1.png, with no obvious shift in position or scale.
Archie's body and face turn toward the camera, not toward the unit door or away from the viewer.
Archie's mouth is slightly open or his expression is serious, as if he is mid-sentence.
Archie's posture is steady and calm. He is not lunging, pointing at the camera, or reaching for the door.
Archie's hands are not touching the shopfront, the door or any goods.
Archie carries the same items as in Archie_biz_sprite_master.png and james_meeting_1.png. If he holds a carrier bag, it is held down at his side and not waved or brandished.
The street, shopfront, signage, parked objects and background match james_exterior.png. Only the characters differ.
The image is the same size and aspect ratio as james_exterior.png, with the street framed the same way.
Archie is drawn at the same pixel scale as the street, not oversized or tiny, and he is readable as the clear focal point.
James is not visible anywhere in the frame, including in a doorway or window.
The inside of the unit is not visible. The door is closed or the opening shows no interior detail.
No legible text or logos anywhere in the image.
No player face is shown (the player is never seen).
Nothing story-critical sits in the bottom ~10% of the image.
The focal point survives the small-phone crop.
